answer_1.quote: we propose a new generation-based task to directly generate sub-event sequences in the free-text form

answer_2.quote: we compute BLEU-1, BLEU-2, ROUGE-L, and BERTScore between them and take the average of each metric over all data

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluation to complement automatic evaluation. As sub-event sequences are complicated and diverse, we decompose them and score every sub-event in the following 3 aspects: Relevance: whether a sub-event is relevant to solving the given process... Conciseness: whether a sub-event is not redundant to others... Orderliness: whether a sub-event is placed in proper order
answer_4.guideline: Relevance: whether a sub-event is relevant to solving the given process. Conciseness: whether a sub-event is not redundant to others in the same sequence. Orderliness: whether a sub-event is placed in proper order, considering its prior sub-events.
